status: First complete-system hypothesis fixed before any system account outcomes; implementation and account source registration pending
origin: Human-directed strong market, strong sector, strong stock and rotation framework of2026-10-18
researchUnit: One whole decision system and continuous shared-cash portfolio; no threshold sweep

universe.scope: All4999 previously fixed surviving local main,ChiNext andSTAR source stocks together; no board-specific choice of best outcomes
universe.classification: CAPCO exact major-industry codes from six publication-dated original snapshots
universe.availability: First independent-calendar session strictly after publication; publication date itself excluded
universe.replacement: Latest known complete snapshot replaces prior map; absent source codes remain unknown for new entry
universe.stateIdentity: Snapshot-specific classification identity; confirmation and leader histories do not bridge a snapshot replacement
universe.industryFeatures: At each T close use only members known at T and their already observed past prices. These are current-known-member historical features, not a retrospectively tradable industry NAV.
universe.noCrosswalk: Do not join TDX sector indices or ambiguous SW historical revisions into this industry classification
universe.themes: First executable version uses reproducible industries. Theme-specific extension requires its own dated membership evidence.

weakMarketStress.scope: Begins at earliest verified snapshot availability; does not claim complete earlier bear-market coverage

featureDefinitions.windows: Trading-calendar slots, never compressed across missing or invalid bars. ReturnK needs K+1 full valid price slots; MAk needs k; prior windows exclude T unless explicitly inclusive.
featureDefinitions.priceValidity: Finite positive OHLCV, consistent OHLC envelope, declared raw basis; amount requires separate positive finite evidence
featureDefinitions.meanNtr20AtT: Inclusive21 valid raw bars ending T;20 true-range/reference terms, arithmetic mean, not Wilder ATR
featureDefinitions.broadTurnover: Frozen sh000001 plus sz399106 amount proxy in CNY; not the sum of research stocks
featureDefinitions.industryReturn: Equal-weight mean member close-to-close return over20 or60 slots, with valid member count and fixed-cohort denominator retained
featureDefinitions.industryBreadth60: Fraction of price-valid known cohort members above their inclusive60-day close mean
featureDefinitions.industryParticipation: Industry same-observable-member summed mean5 amount / summed preceding20 mean amount, divided by the same broad-market amount ratio; activity proxy, not identified net inflow
featureDefinitions.industryRelativeReturn: Industry member mean return minus same-window sh000300 price return, in percentage points
featureDefinitions.percentile: Midrank: (strictly lower count plus half equal count)/known count; stable lexical code order only breaks equal final ordering

admitNewRiskWhen: T broad turnover at least1000000000000 CNY
Inclusive5-day mean turnover at least0.8 times preceding20-day mean
Both SH andSZ composite closes above inclusiveMA60 and MA20 aboveMA60
More than half of observed fixed-cohort stocks aboveMA60; at least95percent of cohort has a valid60-slot breadth input
marketLayer.unknown: No new entry; unknown data does not count as a negative regime observation
marketLayer.marketRiskExit: Both broad composites close below their ownMA60 for3 consecutive known calendar sessions; queue all held positions for next-open risk exit
marketLayer.liquidityFailureAlone: Stops new risk admission; does not itself force liquidation

rawStrongWhen: Relative20 and relative60 returns both positive
sectorLayer.rankingScore: Equal average of cross-industry midrank relative20,relative60 and participation, among feature-valid industries; weights fixed1/3 each
sectorLayer.admission: Choose at most3 highest-score confirmed industries at each close, stable sector code tie break
sectorLayer.concentration: At new-risk admission, held plus reserved industry exposure cannot exceed40percent equity. Appreciation beyond the cap stops further purchases but does not alone force profit-taking.
sectorLayer.sectorRiskExit: For a held known industry, rawStrong is false for3 consecutive known closes; queue its holdings for next-open exit. Unknown does not advance this counter.
sectorLayer.snapshotReplacement: Reset confirmation, failure and role histories for the new snapshot identity; no earlier membership state is rewritten

sharedAdmission: Current valid price and amount; full required windows
Positive60-slot own return and close aboveMA60
Close not above MA20 plus2 times meanNtr20AtT times current close
stockLayer.leaderDefinition: Within the currently known industry,60-slot return midrank at least0.8 and own return above industry mean60
stockLayer.leaderBreakout: Leader closes above preceding20-session high; prior close was not above its corresponding preceding20-session high
stockLayer.leaderReclaim: Leader T low below preceding20-session low and T close above that support
stockLayer.catchup: Own20-slot return no greater than industry mean20 and own within-industry20-return midrank in[0.2,0.8). First close above prior5-session high with T amount above preceding20 mean. A distinct leader identified exactly5 calendar sessions earlier in the same snapshot identity still closes above its currentMA20.
stockLayer.withinSectorOrder: Pattern precedence, then descending own60-return midrank, then descending prior20 amount, then symbol
stockLayer.candidateSchedule: First order industries by fixed sector score, then choose one highest-priority new candidate per selected industry per close, at most5 global candidates. Freeze their order before execution; no T+1 backfill.
stockLayer.rotationMeaning: Catchup follows an already observed leader inside a persistent mainline. New independently confirmed industries can receive available cash as prior industries weaken; daily top-rank changes alone do not force a sale.

portfolioAndExecution.initialFailurePriceAtT: Maximum of preceding10-session low and0.95 times current close. Must be strictly below current close.
portfolioAndExecution.sizing: Minimum of20percent equity budget, remaining40percent industry capacity, available cash, and1percent equity divided by planned per-share price risk; reserve model fees and slippage and round down to source-board lot rules
portfolioAndExecution.decisionClock: All candidates, risk floors, budgets and quantities use T-close known information
portfolioAndExecution.executionClock: One next-calendar-session opening attempt; planned quantity may be reduced by actual cash, lot, documented capacity and actual opening-price risk relative to the fixed failure floor, never increased.
portfolioAndExecution.openingGuard: Reject new buy if opening price is at or below its fixed structural failure level, or above T close times(1+meanNtr20AtT). No chase or delayed entry.
portfolioAndExecution.salePriority: Inherited pending/forced risk sells have priority; blocked sells remain pending, are not canceled by later market or sector improvement
portfolioAndExecution.cash: Do not reserve hypothetical proceeds of a future sale or borrow cash
portfolioAndExecution.partialExitAndConstraints: Keep inherited sell capacity, dated model fees, price-limit and lot constraints, T+1 and partial-fill bookkeeping
portfolioAndExecution.costModel: Use the same explicit inherited LegacyFeePolicy and frozen account fee/slippage/participation configuration for every matched account; no fee-free or zero-slippage promotion
portfolioAndExecution.unknownHeldIndustry: Keep original industry reservation for concentration until classified again; do not manufacture sector deterioration or free capacity from a missing classification
portfolioAndExecution.maximumStockWeightMeaning: 20percent is a new-entry budget cap; price appreciation does not alone force a sale.
portfolioAndExecution.actualOpeningRiskSizing: At opening, reduce quantity if necessary so planned1percent T-close-equity price-risk budget is not increased by an adverse opening gap. Use the maximum of the fixed T structural floor and inherited5percent actual-entry-price backstop. Fees, future gaps and blocked sells can still make realized losses larger.

exits.initialPriceFailure: Queue next-open exit when a valid close reaches the entry plan's fixed structural failure price; inherited5percent entry-price stop remains a backstop
exits.profitProtection: Keep the already audited3-times-prior20 normalized-TR close-time ratchet semantics and persistent next-open execution; no fixed take-profit cap

matchedPrimaryAccounts.scope: All layers and three stock entry branches
Disable only new-entry market admission; common risk exits, source data and budgets stay identical
Disable only strength/confirmation/top3 sector admission; stock roles still use known industry peers, and common risk exits/concentration stay identical
Disable catchup new-entry branch; keep leader breakout/reclaim, shared portfolio rules and risk exits

Same market and sector admission, use highest prior20-amount stock per selected industry instead of stock-pattern/strength admission; same structural sizing, exits and costs. Tradable industry-selection representative control, not a passive complete industry index.

controlInterpretation: Admission/entry interventions change whole cash paths. They do not remove common safety exits and are not additive causal attribution of entire conceptual layers.
benchmarks: Same-date sh000300 price return, without dividend reinvestment or index trading costs
Matched sectorLiquidRepresentative account; report its limitations
requiredValidation: Freeze complete source/code/account configuration before any account outcome
Independently rebuild all market, industry, role, confirmation and entry dates from source calendar windows
Future-poison earlier decisions, snapshot transitions and missing-window tests
Risk-budget and industry-capacity planning, gap rejection and pending-sell persistence tests
Closed-net payoff/PF, continuous curve, cash/fees/open-PnL reconciliation and annual slices
Keep all5 primary accounts plus the weak-market stress path, failed attempts and all rejected opportunities
evaluation: Judge the complete system's net closed payoff,PF,continuous account excess,loss tails,drawdown,exposure,turnover,concentration and cross-year persistence together. Numerical screens remain research proposals. No success claim from one indicator or one selected listing-board subgroup.
permissionBoundary: Isolated local research only; preserve user workspace, no real orders, commit,push,packaging or publication
